label: rem:bring-curve-weyl-e8-prior-art
title: Prior art: the classical $W(E_8)$ symmetry of Bring's curve is a different $E_8$
html:
The automorphism group of the configuration of the 120 tritangent planes of Bring's curve is W(E_8)/\{\pm 1\}, of order 2^{13}\cdot 3^5\cdot 5^2\cdot 7; Yang records this as a consequence of his construction of the E_8 root lattice from the modular curve X(13) and attributes it to Coble [yang2017, \S 1, p. 7].

This is a classical, citable link between Bring's curve and E_8, through the Weyl group acting on tritangent planes. The cyclotomic boundary conjecture uses E_8 in a different way, through quantum dimensions equal to the E_8 Coxeter marks. The two appearances of E_8 are not shown to be related, so this fact is not evidence for the conjecture and should not be read as one.
